feeds.title: A Mighty Girl Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2012, A Mighty Girl is a website and online community that celebrates and empowers young girls and women. The blog section features articles on a range of topics, including self-esteem, confidence, and body positivity.

feeds.title: Medical Express » Self-esteem
feeds.description: Founded in 2011, Medical Express is a news website that provides information on the latest medical and health research. The self-esteem section features articles on the latest research on self-esteem and confidence, as well as practical tips and advice for improving self-esteem.

feeds.title: Superpower Kids » Self-esteem
feeds.description: Founded in 2015, Superpower Kids is a website that provides resources and support for parents and caregivers of children with special needs. The self-esteem blog section focuhello@superpowerkids.netses on helping children with special needs build their self-esteem and confidence.

feeds.title: Sandy Grigsby Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2014, Sandy Grigsby is a personal branding expert and founder of Belladonna Productions. Her blog section focuses on personal development and building self-esteem, providing tips and advice for individuals looking to improve their self-confidence.

feeds.title: The Tao Of Self-Confidence Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2015, The Tao of Self-Confidence is a podcast and blog that features interviews with successful women from different industries. The blog section provides insights and advice on building self-confidence and overcoming self-doubt.

feeds.title: Baggage Reclaim with Natalie Lue Blog
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Natalie Lue creator of Baggage Reclaim and author of Love, Care, Trust & Respect. Find the latest updates to the Baggage Reclaim blog on subjects including healthy relationships, dating, self-esteem, and mental wellbeing.

feeds.title: Self Discovery Blog » Self-Esteem
feeds.description: Founded in 2010, Self Discovery is a blog that aims to help readers improve their personal development and self-awareness. The self-esteem blog section provides practical tips and advice on building self-esteem and confidence.
